name: Toolbox
description: Quality-of-life HUD and trackers. The Toolbelt: your buffs and debuffs, health, focus and Vigor, food and potions, and gear needing repair in one movable strip, optionally only in combat. XP (session, pools, last hour; XP Detailed with levels and a chart); Today (gold, kills, XP, loot, crafting and gathering, optional estimated values from shroudoftheavatar.net); combat stats with Combat Detailed; notifications (guild message, mail, ransoms, rewards, gear needing repair). Commands: /toolbox and /tbx.
author: shawn butts
